title: Q4 Roadmap Planning

segments.speaker: Govind J
segments.text: Alright, let's get started. Today's meeting is about the Q4 roadmap and what we need to ship before the end of the quarter.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Thanks Govind. I wanted to bring up the authentication flow first. We've been getting reports that the login redirect is slow after the OAuth callback — sometimes taking 4 to 5 seconds.

segments.speaker: Arjun Mehta
segments.text: Yeah, I looked into that last week. The issue is we're doing a synchronous DB lookup for the user profile right in the request path. I can move that to a background task and return a loading state to the frontend. Should cut the perceived latency by 70 percent.

segments.speaker: Govind J
segments.text: Good find. Let's make that a priority. Arjun can you have a PR up by Wednesday?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: The second item is the notetaker integration. We decided to use the Google Meet REST API. The main limitation is that the meeting host needs to enable transcription.

segments.speaker: Govind J
segments.text: Right. That's acceptable for our initial customers since they're internal teams. Priya, can you own the Google Meet provider implementation and have a working mock by end of sprint?

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Yes, I'll have the mock done by Thursday and real API integration by next Monday.

segments.speaker: Arjun Mehta
segments.text: One thing worth discussing is the summarization model. We're currently using GPT-4o-mini. For most meetings that's fine, but I worry about very long meetings going over the context window. Should we add a chunking strategy?

segments.speaker: Govind J
segments.text: Good point. Let's keep it simple for now — one call for the full transcript. If a meeting is longer than two hours we can truncate. We'll add chunking as a follow-up. Add a GitHub issue for it.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Last item: the frontend doesn't handle the loading state gracefully when the summary is still being generated. We should add a spinner or a progress indicator.

segments.speaker: Govind J
segments.text: Agreed. Let's add a status polling mechanism — the frontend can poll every 3 seconds while status is SUMMARIZING and then refresh the summary panel once it's COMPLETED.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: I think we've covered everything. Let me summarize the action items.

segments.speaker: Priya Sharma
segments.text: Arjun will fix the OAuth latency with a PR by Wednesday. I'll implement the Google Meet provider mock by Thursday. Govind will add the frontend polling for SUMMARIZING status. Arjun will open a GitHub issue for transcript chunking.

segments.speaker: Govind J
segments.text: Perfect. Let's sync again on Friday. Thanks everyone.
